description.value: SushiWara is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Comox Avenue in Comox on Vancouver Island, serving a range of Japanese dishes including vegetarian options. The restaurant offers online ordering with on-site dining and is wheelchair accessible, making it a practical stop for cyclists touring the Comox Valley.
